question: What is Diginex

beat.line: Diginex is repositioning as one sustainability, data and compliance platform.
beat.headline: ONE PLATFORM
beat.action: A halftone paper screen lowers onto a cream chip and holds centre frame.

sources: Diginex (DGNX) is repositioning itself as a unified sustainability, data and compliance platform.
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: soft violet. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: soft violet.
Subjects: a paper screen; a cream paper chip.
Opens cold on the ground colour; the first subject enters on the first frame.
Action: A halftone paper screen lowers onto a cream chip and holds centre frame.
Ends holding on the paper screen.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "ONE PLATFORM".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "ONE PLATFORM". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Diginex is repositioning as one sustainability, data and compliance platform.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.
expandedPrompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Modern editorial paper collage animation, photographed flat under soft room light in a top-down, overhead Static Shot against an unbroken, matte soft-violet paper ground with subtle natural paper texture. From the upper left, a soft key light casts gentle, shallow contact drop shadows beneath every layered paper element. On the opening frame, a rectangular cream paper chip rapidly drops down into the upper third of the frame, coming to rest with a crisp, slight physical overshoot. Printed boldly across the center of this chip in extra-bold black sans-serif typography is the clean and fully legible text "ONE PLATFORM", which remains completely stable and unmoving throughout the entire shot. Simultaneously, in the lower two-thirds of the frame, a smooth cream-colored paper base chip slides into the center from the lower edge. Immediately following it, a black-and-white halftone photographic paper cutout depicting a blank desktop computer monitor—distinguished by rough, white torn-paper deckle edges—lowers vertically downward onto the cream chip. The screen cutout lands with a sharp, subtle bounce, settling perfectly in the center frame; its display area is completely blank, plain, and unprinted. An adult narrator (S1) with a warm, clear, articulate, and unhurried mid-tone English delivery says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[English] Diginex is repositioning as one sustainability, data and compliance platform.</d> The composition holds firmly on the arranged screen and headline until the end, exhibiting microscopic, tactile stop-motion paper jitters.

overall_soundscape: A crisp tactile paper flick and swift friction whoosh sound accompany the elements sliding into the frame, followed by soft, resonant paper-slap taps as the chips land against the violet ground. A quiet, dry studio room tone persists under the physical foley effects.
